messages.text:
### Known facts
- The proposed supply is **3.3 V**.
- TI lists the TPS22919 recommended input voltage range as **1.6 V to 5.5 V**. Thus, 3.3 V is within that range. ([ti.com](https://www.ti.com/product/TPS22919))

### Analysis and evidence
- Manufacturer source: [TI TPS22919 datasheet](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps22919.pdf).

### Hypotheses to verify
- None for the input-range comparison. This does **not** establish that the part is selected or that current and thermal requirements are satisfied.

### Next steps
- Verify system load current and thermal conditions against the applicable datasheet requirements.

sources.title: TPS22919 data sheet, product information and support | TI.com

messages.text:
### Known facts
- The evidence describes a synthetic software fixture, not a physical measurement.
- It records 501 samples, with a target of 3.3 V and an absolute tolerance of 0.05 V.

### Analysis and evidence
- The allowed range is 3.25–3.35 V.
- The recorded range is **3.29–3.60 V**. The 3.60 V sample is outside the allowed range.
- The recorded result is **fail: 1 sample failed**.

### Hypotheses to verify
- None needed to report the fixture’s recorded result. It does not establish physical hardware performance.

### Next steps
- No project data was modified.
